articles.title: ‘Zombie Drug’ Panic in Bengaluru Debunked: Police Call Viral Video Fake, Issue Notices to 25+
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A viral video claiming that so-called “zombie drugs” have reached Bengaluru has triggered widespread panic online. However, city police have categorically denied the claim, calling it false and misleading.

body.html:
A viral video claiming that so-called “zombie drugs” have reached Bengaluru has triggered widespread panic online. However, city police have categorically denied the claim, calling it false and misleading.

The video, which was widely circulated on social media, led to concern among residents, with many users sharing it without verification.

Taking cognisance, Bengaluru Police launched an investigation and initiated action against those responsible for spreading misinformation. Notices have been issued to actor Duniya Vijay and more than 25 others for sharing the unverified content.

According to sources, retired IPS officer Bhaskar Rao, who also shared the video, is likely to be served a notice as part of the ongoing action.

Police confirmed that the individual who originally uploaded the video has been arrested by Bagalur Police. During questioning, he admitted that the video was based on assumptions after watching similar content from foreign countries. He has since released an apology video.

The Bengaluru City Police Commissioner clarified that the claims made in the video are baseless. A medical examination of the individual seen in the clip found no evidence of drug influence.

Officials emphasised that even though the accuse has apologised, legal action will continue. Authorities are also proceeding against those who amplified the misinformation.

Police have urged citizens to act responsibly on social media, warning that sharing unverified or misleading content can lead to legal consequences and unnecessary public panic.

#Bengaluru #FakeNews #ViralVideo #BreakingNews #Karnataka

articles.title: Tragedy in Chikkamagaluru: Missing Kerala Teen Found Dead in 1,500-ft Gorge After 3-Day Search
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: The search for 14-year-old Shrinanda, who went missing during a family trip to Chikkamagaluru, has ended in tragedy after her body was recovered from a deep gorge.

body.html:
The search for 14-year-old Shrinanda, who went missing during a family trip to Chikkamagaluru, has ended in tragedy after her body was recovered from a deep gorge.

Shrinanda had travelled with a group of around 40 family members from Kerala and went missing on April 7 around 5:30 pm near the Manikyadhara Falls, located at the foothills of Datta Peetha.

According to reports, the family was descending the steps together when Shrinanda, who was walking behind, suddenly disappeared at a turn in the dense forest area. Despite immediate efforts by family members and locals, no trace of her was found initially.

A massive search operation was launched involving over 60 personnel from the police, Forest Department, Fire Services, SDRF, and a dog squad. Five teams were deployed across the forested terrain, and thermal camera drones were also used on the directions of Forest Minister Eshwar Khandre.

After three days of continuous search, her body was found about 5 kilometres away near the Arishinaguppe area, inside a gorge estimated to be around 1,500 feet deep. Rescue teams faced significant challenges in retrieving the body due to the difficult terrain.

Police have begun an investigation into the incident. While initial suspicion points towards possible s***de, the family believes she may have accidentally slipped and fallen.

Authorities are also examining other possibilities, including accidental fall or wildlife involvement. The exact cause of death will be determined after the post-mortem examination.

#Chikkamagaluru #Kerala #BreakingNews #MissingGirl #Tragedy

articles.title: In Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar: Woman Killed at Petrol Pump by Husband, Accused Arrested
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a shocking incident, a 27-year-old woman was murdered by her husband at a petrol pump in broad daylight in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, triggering outrage after the video of the attack went viral.

body.html:
In a shocking incident, a 27-year-old woman was murdered by her husband at a petrol pump in broad daylight in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, triggering outrage after the video of the attack went viral.

The deceased has been identified as Puja Sudam Gawande, a resident of Karmad, while the accused, her second husband Satyam Raosaheb Gawande, has been arrested by Karmad Police.

According to police, Puja was working as a petrol delivery employee at Shiv Samarth Petrol Pump on the Sambhajinagar–Jalna Road for the past one and a half months to support her two children.

On Thursday morning, she reported for duty as usual. Amid a rush of vehicles, the accused arrived at the petrol pump on a motorcycle, allegedly observed her for some time, and then suddenly attacked her.

He reportedly dragged her aside, stabbed her in the back, and then s*it her th**at in full public view. The attack happened so quickly that bystanders were unable to react in time.

Police officials, including Sub-Divisional Police Officer Puja Nangare, Inspector Samratsingh Rajput, and PSI Bharat Nikalje, rushed to the spot upon receiving information.

The accused attempted to flee towards Kachner but was soon apprehended by the police team.

Preliminary investigation revealed that Puja had earlier been married in 2017, and after her first husband’s death in 2023, she married Satyam in 2025. However, the couple reportedly had frequent disputes, and Puja had been living separately.

A friend of the victim, Chhaya Gorakwange, alleged that the accused used to assault Puja and that she had approached the police just days before the incident to file a complaint, which was allegedly not acted upon.

Police have registered a case and further investigation is underway.

#Maharashtra #Sambhajinagar #BreakingNews #CrimeNews #DomesticViolence

articles.title: Road Rage Turns Brutal in Thane: Bus Driver Thrashed Unconscious by Mob, CCTV Captures Horror
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a shocking incident of road rage, a driver of a Mira-Bhayander Municipal Corporation (MBMC) bus was brutally assaulted by a mob in Kopri, Thane, leaving him unconscious with severe injuries. The incident occurred on April 10 at the final bus stop in Thane East.

body.html:
In a shocking incident of road rage, a driver of a Mira-Bhayander Municipal Corporation (MBMC) bus was brutally assaulted by a mob in Kopri, Thane, leaving him unconscious with severe injuries.

The incident occurred on April 10 at the final bus stop in Thane East. The victim, identified as Shankar Gajanan Chavan, was driving a bus from Mira Bhayandar to Thane when a dispute broke out with a two-wheeler rider near Gaimukh Ghat after the biker allegedly cut in front of the moving bus.

Despite reportedly apologising and moving ahead, the biker, identified as Nilesh Shinde, allegedly followed the bus and called his associates.

When the bus reached the Kopri depot, a group of 5–7 people, including a woman, boarded the vehicle and launched a violent attack on the driver. Armed with wooden sticks, they assaulted him inside the bus, dragged him out onto the road, and continued beating him mercilessly.

The driver sustained serious head injuries and lost consciousness. The attackers also reportedly assaulted the conductor and damaged the ticketing machine.

The entire incident was captured on CCTV cameras installed inside the bus, which clearly show the accuse entering the vehicle and carrying out the assault.

Police from Kopri station have registered a case under relevant sections of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), including attempt to murder and obstruction of government duty. The accused are currently absconding, and efforts are underway to identify and arrest them using CCTV footage.

The incident has raised serious concerns over the safety of public transport staff, especially in cases of escalating road rage.

#Thane #RoadRage #BreakingNews #ViralVideo #Maharashtra

articles.title: YouTuber Sisters in Fresh Trouble: Violent Clash in Sambhal Leaves Multiple Injured
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Another case of assault has surfaced involving Sambhal’s controversial YouTuber sisters Mehak and Pari, following a dispute with neighbours that escalated into a violent clash. The incident occurred on Tuesday night in the Asmoli police station area, around 22 km from Sambhal city.

body.html:
Another case of assault has surfaced involving Sambhal’s controversial YouTuber sisters Mehak and Pari, following a dispute with neighbours that escalated into a violent clash.

The incident occurred on Tuesday night in the Asmoli police station area, around 22 km from Sambhal city. According to reports, the dispute began when an argument broke out between children playing outside—Mehak and Pari’s younger sister Nehrul Nisha and a neighbour’s child.

The situation soon escalated into a heated argument between family members from both sides, eventually turning violent.

A video of the incident, now viral on social media, shows Mehak holding a stick, while other family members are seen pelting stones and engaging in a physical altercation. Verbal abuse and threats were also reportedly exchanged during the clash.

Both sides have accused each other of assault. In a complaint, neighbour Bilkis Jahan alleged that Mehak, Pari, and their family entered her house and attacked her and her family members with sticks, leaving several injured, including Noor Hasan.

On the other hand, the sisters’ father Sarfaraz claimed that he was also assaulted and sustained serious head injuries.

Police confirmed that multiple people from both sides were injured and have been sent for medical examination at a community health centre.

Station in-charge Mohit Chaudhary said that a case has been registered based on Sarfaraz’s complaint, while the counter-complaint has also been received. Investigation is underway, and further action will be taken as per findings.

Notably, Mehak and Pari have been involved in several controversies in the past, including cases related to objectionable content and previous assault allegations.

articles.title: Allahabad High Court Judge Yashwant Varma Resigns Amid Cash Recovery Probe; Impeachment Process Ends
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Justice Yashwant Varma has resigned from the Allahabad High Court amid an ongoing inquiry into the alleged recovery of a large stash of cash from his official residence. The resignation was sent to President Droupadi Murmu, though no reason was specified.

body.html:
Justice Yashwant Varma has resigned from the Allahabad High Court amid an ongoing inquiry into the alleged recovery of a large stash of cash from his official residence. The resignation was sent to President Droupadi Murmu, though no reason was specified.

The development comes just as Justice Varma was set to present his defense before an inquiry panel probing corruption allegations. Sources indicate that the prosecution had already concluded arguments, with nine key witnesses examined against him.

Impeachment Proceedings Now Closed
With his resignation, the impeachment process initiated by Parliament is expected to come to an end. Notably, resignation allows him to retain post-retirement benefits such as pension—privileges that would have been forfeited had he been removed through impeachment.

The impeachment motion, backed by over 200 MPs across both Houses, had led to the formation of a three-member inquiry panel under the Judges (Inquiry) Act, 1968 by Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla.

Inquiry Panel & Investigation
The probe panel included:
1. Aravind Kumar (Supreme Court Judge)
2. Shree Chandrashekhar
3. B V Acharya

Earlier findings from an in-house inquiry reportedly suggested that Justice Varma had “secret or active control” over the cash recovered.

Cash Recovery Controversy
The controversy dates back to March 14, 2025, when partially burnt currency notes were allegedly discovered in a storeroom at his official residence in Lutyens Delhi during his tenure at the Delhi High Court.

Justice Varma had denied any connection to the cash, stating neither he nor his family stored money there.

Following the incident, the Supreme Court of India withdrew his judicial work and transferred him back to his parent court in Allahabad, directing that no judicial responsibilities be assigned.

Resignation Letter
In his letter, Justice Varma expressed “deep anguish” over his decision but chose not to disclose the reasons behind stepping down. A copy was also sent to Chief Justice of India Surya Kant.

Legal & Procedural Context
Justice Varma had earlier challenged the constitution of the inquiry panel, arguing procedural lapses in forming the committee without joint consultation between the Lok Sabha Speaker and the Rajya Sabha Chairman.

Despite these objections, proceedings continued until his resignation effectively halted the process.

articles.title: Dhar Horror: Wife, Lover Arrested for Husband’s Murder; Robbery Story Turns Out Fake
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a shocking case from Dhar, police have cracked a sensational murder that was initially projected as a robbery. The accused wife Priyanka Purohit and her lover Kamlesh Purohit have been arrested, while co-accused Surendra Bhati remains on the run.

body.html:
In a shocking case from Dhar, police have cracked a sensational murder that was initially projected as a robbery. The accused wife Priyanka Purohit and her lover Kamlesh Purohit have been arrested, while co-accused Surendra Bhati remains on the run.

The victim, Devkrishna Purohit, a chilli trader, was murdered on the night of April 7 in Gondikheda Charan under Rajod police station limits. Initially, Priyanka told police that unidentified robbers had entered the house, killed her husband, and looted jewellery and cash.

However, during investigation, inconsistencies in her statements raised suspicion. With the help of forensic evidence, cyber inputs, and technical analysis, police uncovered the truth. Under interrogation, Priyanka eventually confessed to plotting the murder along with her lover.

Murder Planned Over Affair

Police revealed that Priyanka had been in a relationship with Kamlesh since 2017. Disturbed by her marriage, she conspired to eliminate her husband. Kamlesh allegedly hired Surendra Bhati for ₹1 lakh to execute the killing, paying ₹50,000 in advance.

On the night of the crime, the house door was deliberately left open. Surendra entered and attacked Devkrishna with a sharp weapon while he was asleep. Kamlesh stood guard outside. After the murder, Priyanka raised an alarm 10–15 minutes later to make it appear like a robbery.

Fake Robbery Story Exposed
To mislead investigators, Priyanka staged the crime scene—scattering household items and falsely claiming theft of jewellery worth ₹3 lakh and ₹50,000 cash. However, police later recovered these items from inside the house, exposing the fabricated story.

Family’s Serious Allegations
The victim’s mother Laxmibai and sister Jyoti alleged that Priyanka frequently fought with the family, abused them, and had long been involved with Kamlesh. They claimed she often threatened to implicate them in false cases.

Key Revelations
1. Marriage between Priyanka and Devkrishna dates back to 2011
2. Affair with Kamlesh began in 2017
3. Contract killing deal finalized for ₹1 lakh
4. ₹50,000 paid in advance to Surendra
5. Crime executed on April 7 after earlier delay

Police, led by SP Mayank Awasthi, confirmed that the murder was a pre-planned conspiracy driven by the extramarital affair.

Further investigation is ongoing, including forensic analysis to determine if sedatives were used before the murder. Meanwhile, efforts are underway to arrest the absconding accuse.

#Dhar #MadhyaPradesh #CrimeNews #MurderCase #BreakingNews

articles.title: Dating App Trap in Noida: Woman Lures Men, Intoxicates Them, Steals Valuables—2 Arrested
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a major breakthrough, police from Sector-126 in Noida have busted a gang involved in cheating and theft by targeting victims through online dating platforms. Two accused, including a woman, have been arrested and stolen jewellery along with cash has been recovered.

body.html:
In a major breakthrough, police from Sector-126 in Noida have busted a gang involved in cheating and theft by targeting victims through online dating platforms. Two accused, including a woman, have been arrested and stolen jewellery along with cash has been recovered.

The case came to light after a complaint was filed by a youth, who said he connected with a woman identifying herself as “Tanu Verma” on a dating app. After initial conversations, she invited him to meet at the Supernova Spira.

During the meeting, the accused allegedly made the victim consume excessive alcohol, leaving him heavily intoxicated. Taking advantage of his condition, she fled with his valuables, including a gold chain, ring, bracelet, and around ₹27,000 in cash.

Acting on the complaint, police registered a case and launched an investigation. Based on local intelligence and informer inputs, the accused were apprehended near the Sector-94 underpass.

The arrested have been identified as Sita Chakravarti, who used aliases Tanu Verma and Maya, and her accomplice Sagar Chauhan.

During interrogation, the woman confessed that she used dating apps and social media to target single men. After gaining their trust, she would arrange meetings, intoxicate them, and steal their belongings. Her associate allegedly sold the stolen jewellery in the market, and the proceeds were shared between them.

Police recovered a gold chain, a gold ring, and ₹13,000 in cash from their possession.

A case has been registered under relevant sections, and further investigation is underway. Authorities have also issued an advisory urging citizens to remain cautious while interacting with strangers on dating apps and to take safety precautions before meeting in person.

articles.title: Viral Fight at Etawah Junction: GRP Arrests Two After Station Scuffle Sparks Panic
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Swift action was taken by the GRP after a video of a violent altercation at the gate of Etawah Junction went viral on social media.

body.html:
Swift action was taken by the GRP after a video of a violent altercation at the gate of Etawah Junction went viral on social media.

According to police, two accused — Vicky Jha, a resident of Vaishali in Bihar, and Shiv Kumar, a resident of Bulandshahr — were arrested for assaulting Devendra Babu, a resident of Auraiya district.

The incident created panic among passengers at the station, as the accused were seen arguing and physically assaulting the victim. The situation was brought under control after GRP personnel reached the spot promptly.

A case has been registered under Crime No. 14/2026 with relevant sections of the IPC, including charges related to assault and breach of peace. Additional sections have also been invoked against the accused.

Police officials stated that both accused will be produced before the court soon.

The operation was carried out by the GRP Etawah Junction team under the leadership of Station House Officer Jitendra Kumar, along with Sub-Inspector Komal Kuntal and Constable Shailendra Singh.

Authorities have assured that strict vigilance will continue to maintain law and order at railway stations.

articles.title: ‘Collection’ Clash or Duty Dispute? On-Duty Fight Between Traffic Personnel in Farrukhabad Sparks Ro
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A video showing two traffic personnel engaging in a physical altercation in Farrukhabad has gone viral, triggering outrage and raising questions over discipline within the force.

body.html:
A video showing two traffic personnel engaging in a physical altercation in Farrukhabad has gone viral, triggering outrage and raising questions over discipline within the force.

Initial reports claimed that the clash broke out over alleged “collection” money, with one person saying ₹5,000 had been collected while the other insisted it was ₹2,800. The argument reportedly escalated into a scuffle, with both exchanging kicks and punches in public view.

However, police have refuted these claims. According to the Additional Superintendent of Police, the viral video was misleading.

Officials clarified that the incident took place near Gate No. 2 of the railway station in the Kotwali Farrukhabad area under Fatehgarh. The individuals involved were a Home Guard, identified as Ramakant Agnihotri, and a PRD jawan deployed on traffic duty.

As per the official version, 07 April 2026 around 3 pm, the PRD jawan sat on a nearby bench during duty hours, which was objected to by the Home Guard. This led to an argument that soon turned into a physical scuffle. A traffic head constable present at the spot intervened and separated the two.

Police stated that the claim of a monetary dispute is “completely false” and that the incident was a case of indiscipline during duty.

Both personnel have been removed from traffic duty, sent back to their respective departments, and departmental action has been recommended against them.

#UttarPradesh #Farrukhabad #PoliceNews #ViralVideo #BreakingNews
